# People photos for tests

- `grace_hopper.jpg`: Rear Admiral Grace M. Hopper, official U.S. Navy photograph (1984), a work
  of the U.S. federal government and so in the public domain. Copied from matplotlib's
  `mpl-data/sample_data/`, where it ships with the library. Used to check that a person is still
  counted after Koʻz blurs the face (`tests/test_blur_keeps_people.py`). Never a camera frame.
